title: Account Rule on One Wayfare Bikes and Scooters Plan per Bike Share System
content:
**1.** A rider may hold one Wayfare Bikes and Scooters plan per bike share system at a time, and at most 3 plans in total.

**2.** A plan is bought only when the rider has no plan in pending payment, active or suspended status in the same system; moving to another plan cancels the current one under its own refund rule and buys the new one.

**3.** Whether a rider already holds a plan in a system is read from the company's plan records before the purchase, not from the rider's account of it. The records consulted are the plans of the same rider in the same bike share system as the purchase, and their status.

**4.** The systems are those the plans are sold in, as listed in the plan schedule. The condition in clause 2 looks only at plans in the same system as the purchase.

## Clause 2 laid out

| Rider's plan in the same system as the purchase | Status of that plan | Purchase in that system |
|---|---|---|
| none | — | may be bought |
| one plan | pending payment | not bought |
| one plan | active | not bought |
| one plan | suspended | not bought |
| one plan | expired | may be bought |
| one plan | cancelled | may be bought |

Only the three statuses pending payment, active and suspended stand in the way of a purchase; an expired or cancelled plan in the same system does not.

## Hypothetical cases

- A rider holding an active Wayfare Bikes Annual plan in Denver asks to buy a Day Pass in Salt Lake City. The Denver plan is in another system, so the Salt Lake City purchase is not blocked by it.
- A rider whose Phoenix Monthly Pass is suspended asks to buy another plan in Phoenix. A plan in suspended status exists in the same system, so no plan is bought there.
- A rider holding an active Wayfare Bikes Monthly Pass in Phoenix wishes to move to the Annual plan in Phoenix. Moving plans cancels the Monthly Pass under the Monthly Pass's own refund rule and buys the Annual plan.
- A rider whose Denver Annual plan has expired buys a new plan in Denver: the expired plan does not block the purchase.
